import pandas as pd

def main():
    # List all source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_58/training_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_58/training_1.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_58/training_2.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_58/training_3.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_58/training_4.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_58/training_5.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_58/training_6.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_58/training_7.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_58/training_8.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_58/training_9.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_58/training_10.csv"
    ]

    # Read all source CSV files into a list of DataFrames
    # Use index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column as per Hint 24
    dfs = [pd.read_csv(path, index_col=0) for path in source_files]

    # All source tables have the same schema ['code', 'name'] which matches the target schema exactly.
    # According to Hint 2 and Hint 4, we should UNION all source tables.

    # Concatenate all dataframes vertically (union)
    combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # The target schema is ['code': integer, 'name': string]
    # Ensure 'code' is integer type and 'name' is string type
    combined_df['code'] = combined_df['code'].astype(int)
    combined_df['name'] = combined_df['name'].astype(str)

    # The target examples show duplicates (e.g., code=10 with "Rural development" repeated),
    # and the prompt does not require removing duplicates.
    # So we keep duplicates as is.

    # Write the combined dataframe to the target CSV file
    output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_58/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    combined_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
